title: Best strategy recommendation
description: Determine the optimal strategy for a given player based on the game tree.
query: Given the game tree and payoff structure, what is the optimal strategy for each player? Which player has the stronger position?

title: Expected utility calculation
description: Calculate expected utility values accounting for chance node probabilities.
query: What is the expected utility for each player's strategic choices, taking into account the probabilities at chance nodes?

title: Dominant strategy identification
description: Identify whether any player has a dominant strategy.
query: Does any player have a dominant strategy — one that yields a better payoff regardless of what the other player does?

title: Game of chicken analysis
description: Analyse the scenario through the lens of a classic game of chicken.
query: How does this scenario compare to a classic game of chicken? Who blinked first, and was the outcome stable or is further escalation likely?

title: Information asymmetry assessment
description: Assess what each player knew and how information gaps shaped decisions.
query: What information asymmetries exist between the players? How might incomplete information have affected their strategic choices?

title: Credible threats and commitments
description: Evaluate which threats and commitments in the game are credible.
query: Which threats or commitments made by each player are credible? Are there any bluffs, and how does credibility affect the equilibrium?

title: Payoff sensitivity analysis
description: Assess how changes in payoff values would alter optimal strategies.
query: How sensitive are the strategic conclusions to changes in payoff values? If the utility numbers shifted slightly, would the optimal strategies change?

title: Real-world implications
description: Translate the game-theoretic analysis into real-world strategic implications.
query: What are the real-world implications of this game theory analysis? What lessons can be drawn about strategic decision-making in this domain?
